releases.title: CLI 0.11.0-beta.9
releases.summary: This beta makes startup failures easier to diagnose. Starting or restarting an installation now waits for the app to respond before reporting success.

releases.title: App / runtime 0.6.0
releases.summary: Chat: Conversations keep working when you switch chats or start a new one. The sidebar shows running conversations and marks background work as finished until you open it. Stop still applies only to the selected conversation.

releases.title: App / runtime 0.5.6
releases.summary: Dependencies: Update networking, encryption, certificate trust, and web-content processing dependencies to address high and critical security advisories.

releases.title: App / runtime 0.5.5
releases.summary: Chat: Saved conversations load with compressed responses, reducing the data transferred over slower connections while preserving the complete history.

releases.title: App / runtime 0.5.3
releases.summary: Branding: The app icon and browser tab favicon have been updated to the new omnideck mark, with the favicon now rendered as a transparent disc.

releases.title: CLI 0.11.0-beta.7

releases.summary: Updates: What’s new now opens a dedicated app release page with the changes included in that version. Older app versions keep their existing release-note links.

releases.summary: This beta separates the graphical desktop host from the standalone CLI command and improves browser cleanup for scheduled routines. It is an in-place upgrade; you do not need to uninstall beta.8 first.

releases.summary: Beta.8 brings the complete omnideck agent workspace to Windows, macOS, and Linux in a guided desktop application. It adds reliable native zoom and rolls up the latest improvements to setup, downloads, updates, and day-to-day desktop use.
